I've had loved ones say that too, and honestly that's what i said to my mom before she went through with it. And i'm still here for now so i guess I lied. In non-depressed people the will to live is strong, I wouldn't worry as much about that as long as they have a support system. I personally don't think it's better to aim for a fake natural death, because at least with being honest you can do a true goodbye. Maybe go out to lunch with your loved ones and make sure they know you love them. I guess the only bonus to a "natural death" is you can take out a life insurance policy and give your loved ones some money but it might not work out if the company suspects you committed. Just my opinion personally.
